tool.name: ATRIUM NLP enrichment
tool.description: lemmatises, tags and parses Czech text lines and finds their named entities (LINDAT UDPipe and NameTag)
tool.command: #import re ## The document id is the line table's file name: the table is linked under its collection name, ## and its ALTO beside it under the same id. #set $stem = re.sub(r'(\.lines)?\.(csv|txt|xlsx)$', '', str($lines.element_identifier), flags=re.IGNORECASE) #set $stem = re.sub(r'[^\w.\-]', '_', $stem) or 'document' #set $ext = {'csv': 'csv', 'txt': 'txt', 'xlsx': 'xlsx'}.get(str($lines.ext), 'csv') #set $layout = 'alto' if $alto else 'none' JOB="\$PWD" && mkdir -p in out tmp layout/alto && ln -s '$lines' 'in/${stem}.${ext}' && #if $alto: ln -s '$alto' 'layout/alto/${stem}.alto.xml' && #end if ## Every path of the config points into the job directory; the stages run from /app and read it. python3 '$write_config' /app/config_api.txt "\$JOB" '$layout' && python3 /app/run_pipeline.py --config "\$JOB/config_api.txt" --strict-empty --lang cs $skip_untrustworthy --merged-out "\$JOB/out/paradata.json" #if $baseline: --document-json '$baseline' #end if --document-json-out "\$JOB/out/record.json" && test -s "\$JOB/out/record.json" && mv 'out/UDP_NE/${stem}/${stem}.conllu' '$conllu' && mv 'out/UDP_NE/${stem}/${stem}.csv' '$tokens' && ## A document without entities has no summary table: its dataset stays empty. if [ -f out/summary_ne_counts.csv ]; then mv out/summary_ne_counts.csv '$entities'; else : > '$entities'; fi && mv 'out/TEITOK/${stem}.teitok.xml' '$teitok' && mv out/paradata.json '$paradata' && mv out/record.json '$record'

configfiles.configfile:
import re import sys
template, job, layout = sys.argv[1:4] overrides = { "OUTPUT_DIR": f'"{job}/out"', "INPUT_TABLES_DIR": f'"{job}/in"', "WORK_DIR": f'"{job}/tmp"', "TEMP_TXT_DIR": f'"{job}/tmp/TXT_EXTRACT"', "CHUNK_DIR": f'"{job}/tmp/CHUNKS"', "PARADATA_DIR": f'"{job}/out/paradata"', "LOG_FILE": f'"{job}/out/processing.log"', "CONLLU_INPUT_DIR": f'"{job}/out/UDP"', "TSV_INPUT_DIR": f'"{job}/out/NE"', "SUMMARY_OUTPUT_DIR": f'"{job}/out/UDP_NE"', "TEITOK_OUTPUT_DIR": f'"{job}/out/TEITOK"', "INPUT_ALTO_DIR": f'"{job}/layout/alto"' if layout == "alto" else '""', "INPUT_PAGES_DIR": '""', "TEITOK_FLEXICONV_DIR": f'"{job}/layout/flexiconv"', "FLEXICONV_ANNOTATE": '"false"', "TEITOK_ENRICHMENT": '"false"', "SKIP_UNTRUSTWORTHY_LINES": '"false"', } assign = re.compile(r"^\s*(?:export\s+)?([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*=") seen = set() lines = [] with open(template, encoding="utf-8") as handle: for raw in handle: match = assign.match(raw) if match and match.group(1) in overrides: lines.append(f"{match.group(1)}={overrides[match.group(1)]}\n") seen.add(match.group(1)) else: lines.append(raw) lines += [f"{key}={value}\n" for key, value in overrides.items() if key not in seen] with open(f"{job}/config_api.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle: handle.writelines(lines)

param.name: lines
param.label: Line table
param.help: The text lines of one document, in reading order: a CSV with a 'text' column (and page_num, line_num, categ when it has them), such as the line table of ATRIUM OCR post-processing; or plain text, a form feed starting a new page. For a collection, the tool runs once per document; the element name becomes the document id.

param.name: alto
param.label: ALTO of the same document
param.help: Gives the TEITOK file and the entities their positions on the page. For collections, the ALTO collection must list the documents in the same order.

param.name: skip_untrustworthy
param.label: Leave out lines marked Trash, Garbage, Inverted or Empty
param.help: Uses the line table's categ column (ATRIUM OCR line quality).

param.name: baseline
param.label: Document record to add to
param.help: An ATRIUM document record from an earlier stage; the entities are added to it.

tool.help:
**What it does**
Annotates the text lines of one Czech document with the LINDAT services of ÚFAL, Charles University: UDPipe 2 (``czech-pdt-ud-2.15-241121``) tokenises, lemmatises, tags and parses it, and NameTag 3 (``nametag3-multilingual-onto-260521``) finds its named entities. With the document's ALTO, the result is also written as a TEITOK file in which each word keeps its position on the page. It runs the ATRIUM NLP enrichment (`ufal/atrium-nlp-enrich`_), release @TOOL_VERSION@.
**Input**
- *Line table*: the lines in reading order, as a CSV with a ``text`` column (``page_num``, ``line_num`` and ``categ`` are used when present). The line table of *ATRIUM OCR post-processing* is one. Plain text works too; a form feed starts a new page. - *ALTO* (optional): the same document's OCR, for positions in TEITOK and in the entities.
Czech only.
**Outputs**
- *CoNLL-U with entities* (tabular): UDPipe's CoNLL-U, each word's entity in ``NER=`` of the last column. - *Tokens* (CSV): one row per word, with its page, lemma, entity and UDPipe's features. - *Entities per page* (CSV): the most frequent entities of each page, with their types and counts. - *TEITOK* (TEI XML): the text, its annotation and, with ALTO, each word's bounding box. - *Document record* (JSON): the ATRIUM document record with the ``entities`` block. - *Paradata* (JSON): the run's provenance, with the components and their licences.
**Network and licences**
Every job calls LINDAT UDPipe and NameTag over the internet (no key). The code is MIT; the UDPipe and NameTag models are CC BY-NC-SA; the paradata lists each component's licence.
.. _`ufal/atrium-nlp-enrich`: https://github.com/ufal/atrium-nlp-enrich
